metadata.description: Free Claude Code review skills and a Supabase grants guard plugin for Next.js + Supabase + Stripe.

plugins.name: ship-ready-skills
plugins.description: Five review skills (tools: Read, Grep, Glob): supabase-rls-review, supabase-grants-check, stripe-webhook-review, launch-security-check and unthrottled-route-check, for Supabase migrations and grants, client code, Stripe webhook handlers, and AI or checkout routes with no rate limiter.

plugins.name: supabase-grants-check
plugins.description: Skill + SQL checker + a mod that refuses GRANT ALL or write grants to anon or PUBLIC, and role grants to anon/authenticated. /grants-check shows how to run the checker.
